title: Uwell Caliburn A2S Replacement Pod 1.2Ohm - 4 Pack
description: These replacement Uwell Caliburn A2S pods feature a transparent design, allowing users to see through the pod as they fill it with E-Liquid. The Caliburn A2S 2ml pods can be refilled by removing the cap to reveal the side-fill port, which helps to prevent leaks and debris collecting in the mouthpiece. A2S Pods connect to the battery securely, and a tighter airflow ensures a richer, more intense vape than the original Caliburn vape kit. The pods feature a built-in 1.2ohm mesh coil that eliminates the hassle of replacing coils completely. When your pod’s coil begins to lose flavour, simply replace the whole pod for a new one. Designed for a perfect MTL (mouth-to-lung) experience, the pods are versatile enough that they can be used with High-PG , 50/50 and Nicotine Salt E-Liquids. The Uwell Caliburn A2S Pod kit features an improved MTL draw, a long-lasting 520mAh battery and effortlessly simple and satisfying Auto-Inhale activation, all with the performance and flavour you’ve come to expect from a Uwell Caliburn kit.
